name: Olympia
beschreibung: The Hotel Olympia is located in the center of Ischgl, directly on Silvrettastraße and just a few minutes' walk from the Silvretta-Bahn. The accommodation offers a classic Alpine atmosphere with alpine furniture and cozy lounge areas. Guests will find comfortable rooms and an in-house restaurant. A small wellness area invites guests to relax after a day on the slopes. The location is ideal for skiers and hikers who want to easily reach the public transport network and the mountain railways.
